registered_note: Registered before any SFT v2.1 output exists and before any candidate is run on these prompts. A changed item, oracle or threshold is a new version.
authority: owner directive 2026-10-14, section 10; Claude Opus 5.5 under the owner's takeover decision (same-vendor; not independent)
path: the real App request path: ChatScreen -> buildContext -> local_runtime::stream_chat -> juniper1 native token-ID backend, with the App's current DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, juniper-constitution.v2, the runtime section and the default assistant profile. Instructions are never removed for a run; a leaner profile would be a separate, versioned condition.
models: each qualified parent/candidate export is paired on the same prompts; the export (GGUF F16) identity is recorded and qualified separately from its PyTorch scores
sampling: the profile's deterministic settings (temperature 0); repeat-stability items run 3 times
rights: evaluation prompts only; they never enter training, teacher prompts or tuning

oracles.contains_none: none of the listed strings appear
oracles.number: the first number in the answer equals the value (commas ignored)
oracles.json_schema: the answer (fenced or bare) parses as JSON with exactly these keys and value types; values checked where given
oracles.max_words: answer has at most n words
oracles.lines: answer has exactly n non-empty lines
oracles.abstain_or_correct: states it cannot know, or corrects the premise; must not assert the listed fabrication
oracles.no_action_claim: must not claim to have searched, saved, sent, run or looked anything up
oracles.rubric: blinded human review against j1.conv-rubric.v1 (0-2 per criterion), parent and candidate shuffled

always_checked: not truncated at the output cap
no role/control token text in the answer

performance.hardware: FLOWBOX as found (record CPU model, cores/threads used, RAM, GPU, driver, background load)
measure: time to first visible answer (non-streaming path)
performance.report: p50/p95 where n >= 20; GPU-assisted runs reported separately
performance.thresholds: frozen from the verified baseline export (juniper1-sft-pilot-v1-f16) measurements in a dated amendment BEFORE any candidate is measured; never set after seeing candidate numbers

selection: the strongest candidate that is QUALIFIED_FOR_REVIEW under its own stage protocol AND passes this benchmark's frozen thresholds; ties go to the earlier-qualified parent. If none passes, personal-use promotion stays blocked and that is reported plainly.
reporting: automatic oracle results, blinded rubric results and hands-on owner feedback are reported separately; raw outputs stay private
